content: No single canonical Vitest-native helper for 'fake binary on PATH' fixtures; the standard hand-rolled pattern (used broadly across Node CLI-testing) is: create a temp directory per test/suite, write an executable script there named identically to the real binary (e.g. 'claude'), chmod 0o755, then spawn the real runner code with env.PATH =  so child_process.spawn('claude', ...) resolves to the fixture instead of a real install. Clean up the temp dir in afterEach/afterAll.
